mission_result: Recovered the stalled mobile risk lane as a preserve-first regression and falsification contract. prometeo-mobile is a logical swarm surface over the existing Universal Host, not evidence for a second mobile app. The earlier UX blocker saying Page Thread Bridge had no return is now stale: a qualifying candidate RETURN+DONE pair exists, so the risk frontier moves from bridge absence to preserving causal identity, privacy, deduplication and authority through local integration.

non_obvious_findings: The highest-risk mobile 'improvement' now is forking product identity/authority, not missing responsive layout.
A served source under candidate/ is a concrete automation trap proving path names cannot determine lifecycle truth.

The dependency frontier changed during the worker wave: an older UX finding became stale after Page Thread Bridge recovery, so integration must refresh durable evidence instead of freezing audit conclusions.
Targeted bridge tests and end-to-end mobile/browser acceptance are separate truth ceilings.
CURRENT_GRAPH lag and exact Served manifest authority can coexist at different granularity; newest-wins reconciliation would itself regress truth.

deduplication.decision: Do not emit duplicate mobile redesign/privacy/bridge work. Feed this risk matrix into the already-prepared mobile PLAN/LOCAL-INTEGRATE lanes; mobile REUSE already has a fresh recovery worker.

unresolved_boundaries: No durable mobile-only human literal authorizes a second app, independent page identity, breakpoint system or gesture grammar.
No durable mapping object equates surface_id prometeo-mobile to a concrete catalog page_id; do not invent one.
Page Thread Bridge remains candidate evidence and targeted tests do not prove browser/device Human Acceptance.
